name: pm-issue
description: Issues on this project: product framing for a reader who decides what to build next.

rules.name: problem-not-prescription
rules.description: The issue states the problem or opportunity and what the user must accomplish to call it solved.
criteria: The first section names the problem or the opportunity.
A section states what the user can do once the issue is solved.
No sentence names a technology, component, file, or implementation step.

rules.name: idea-density
rules.description: Every sentence carries a new idea. An issue runs denser than a memo.
criteria: No sentence restates an earlier sentence.
No sentence exists only to introduce the next one.
Each section adds a decision, a constraint, or an outcome.

anchors.1: Most sentences restate or set up.
anchors.3: Some filler; each section still adds one thing.
anchors.5: No sentence can go without a loss.
